bug_semantics: The WebDAV servlet parsed attacker-controlled XML with a namespace-aware DocumentBuilderFactory that did not disable entity-reference expansion or DOCTYPE declarations. XML supplied to LOCK, PROPFIND, or PROPPATCH could therefore resolve external entities, enabling XXE disclosure and resource consumption.
flaw_origin: Commit a0714b5a517432903ae254ef99a371b766ac8737 added the WebDAV bridge and first wrote AbstractMethod.getDocumentBuilder() with the insecure default DocumentBuilderFactory configuration. Its parent f5c2471114c87d2e0b36cd9b337018617dbdc1c0 has no AbstractMethod.java at that path.
ai_marker: No AI marker is present on the BIC: author and committer are ian <ianopolous@protonmail.com>, the subject is 'Implement a webdav bridge to Peergos', the body is empty, and there are no trailers or AI-attribution statements.
evidence: CVE.org CNA record CVE-2025-4639 is PUBLISHED and identifies CWE-611 in Peergos WebDav servlet AbstractMethod.java, affecting version 1.1.0, with PR #1267 as its sole source reference.
GHSA-7jmx-9c9v-p8w8 describes the same getDocumentBuilder() XXE and says Peergos is affected through version 1.1.0; its affected and patched version fields are otherwise unknown.

git log -S for 'protected DocumentBuilder getDocumentBuilder()' identifies only a0714b5a517432903ae254ef99a371b766ac8737 as the first-writing commit; git blame assigns the factory creation, namespace configuration, and builder creation to that commit.

a0714b5a517432903ae254ef99a371b766ac8737 is a one-parent public commit adding 46 files and 7,088 lines; its target file is new, while git cat-file confirms the target path is absent from parent f5c2471114c87d2e0b36cd9b337018617dbdc1c0. No finer public member exists in this repository history, so the surviving aggregate commit is the atomic BIC under the protocol.

PR #1267 contains one direct commit, 77caabe40a8eff490a27aab47c9337cf2e8edbfe, adding documentBuilderFactory.setExpandEntityReferences(false); merge commit 8a90a180b46602a1da73e7136edc8cb317bdebac has parents de4816a65cda6e7bc0da9f35fa2a564326d03f8f and 77caabe40a8eff490a27aab47c9337cf2e8edbfe, and its target-file tree matches the direct fix.

The direct fix parent de4816a65cda6e7bc0da9f35fa2a564326d03f8f still creates a namespace-aware builder without disabling entity-reference expansion; the fix adds the mitigation at the vulnerable factory construction site.

The BIC metadata has human author and committer ian <ianopolous@protonmail.com>, an empty body, no trailers, and no AI marker. The imported file carries Apache Software Foundation copyright dating to 1999/2004; there is no BIC-local evidence of AI generation.
reasoning: This is a real, published XXE vulnerability rather than a withdrawn or rejected advisory. The vulnerable source-to-sink chain is WebDAV request XML parsed by callers DoLock, DoPropfind, and DoProppatch through the shared insecure getDocumentBuilder(). The smallest surviving Peergos history object that first wrote that configuration is a0714b5a517432903ae254ef99a371b766ac8737; its immediate parent is verifiable and lacks the file, and the commit is not a merge or squash with reconstructable members. PR #1267 directly changes that factory configuration and lands unchanged through merge 8a90a180b46602a1da73e7136edc8cb317bdebac. Because AI-role judgment is restricted to the BIC and that BIC has human identity plus no AI marker or trailer, the supported verdict is NOT_AI.
remaining_gap: The CNA establishes affected version 1.1.0, but GHSA lists patched versions as unknown and the repository publishes no local or remote Git tags, so the first fixed release/version cannot be independently verified. The later commit 77c5ef8bb332131fdb4b24516124f46b7a33e61d additionally disallows DOCTYPE declarations in 2026; no advisory source links it to CVE-2025-4639, so it is recorded only as later hardening and is not substituted for the advisory's direct fix.
